task_completion.description: Open the aav2_genome.fasta file in UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE window shows 'aav2_genome.fasta' loaded in the project view or sequence view.

task_completion.description: Configure the 'Find Inverted Repeats' tool with min length 30bp, 100% identity, and max distance 5000bp.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or side panel in UGENE showing the parameters: min length 30, identity 100%, and distance 5000.

task_completion.description: Annotate the found repeat pairs with the label 'ITR'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The sequence view shows annotations labeled 'ITR' at the ends of the sequence.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated sequence to the specified GenBank path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or file explorer showing the file being saved as 'aav2_annotated.gb' in the '~/UGENE_Data/aav2_results/' directory.

task_completion.description: Create a text report with sequence length, repeat count, coordinates, and biological function.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or UGENE's internal editor) showing 'itr_report.txt' with content including '4679' (length), repeat coordinates, and a description of ITR function.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE graphical interface rather than just terminal commands to process the genome.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with UGENE menus, dialogs, and the sequence viewer.

integrity.description: The repeat coordinates in the report match the visual annotations in UGENE.
integrity.visual_evidence: The start/end positions visible in the UGENE annotation table match the text written in the report.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file but went through the export process.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog is visible during the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The AAV2 genome (NC_001401.2) is exactly 4679 bp long. The annotations must be named 'ITR'. The output files must be located in '~/UGENE_Data/aav2_results/'. ITRs are typically found at the extreme ends of the genome (near 1 and 4679).
